No returns are promised. Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation.

## Services
- [Mutual fund distributor in Pune and Ahmedabad](https://assetzpro.com/mutual-funds): AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor, SIP and goal planning, ELSS, free SIP calculators.
- [Real estate consultant in Pune and Ahmedabad](https://assetzpro.com/real-estate): MahaRERA and GujRERA registered agents, RERA check before every visit.
- [Life and health insurance in Pune and Ahmedabad](https://assetzpro.com/insurance): term, health, motor and business cover explained by an IRDAI individual agent, with an insurance needs calculator.
- [Home loan and loan against property consultant](https://assetzpro.com/loans): home loan, LAP, business and personal loan comparison across banks and NBFCs, with EMI and eligibility calculators.
